skill.summary: Internal reasoning from <think> blocks leaks into the final user-facing reply instead of being stripped.

latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of think-block-leakage.
- Detects and describes symptoms of model internal reasoning leaking into user-facing replies.
- Provides guidelines for identifying and addressing reasoning tag leaks and planning language in replies.
- Recommends prompt refinement and output post-processing to prevent information leakage.
